identity.title: Deterministic Qualification Packet Acceptance Gate
identity.objective: Implement one deterministic local/offline S10-GATE-QUAL-01 acceptance gate over the existing immutable NON_WALLET QualificationCandidate. The gate revalidates the packet, accepts an append-only descendant current Alpha snapshot, rebinds the exact AF1 receipt and exact provenance-manifest set, evaluates eight closed readiness dimensions, and emits one immutable qualification-only receipt with QUAL_PASS, QUAL_FAIL or QUAL_INCONCLUSIVE. QUAL_PASS means only eligible to begin separately authorized candidate-specific WP170 work; no real candidate evaluation, receipt persistence, WP170 construction/OOS, economics, paper, execution, live, Gate C, network, credentials or merge authority is included.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-GATE-QUAL-01. The additive qualification_gate.py module, package exports, focused tests, gate contract/status/spec artifacts and bounded predecessor/roadmap/status compatibility edits disappear. S10-QUAL-01 QualificationCandidate, Alpha/AF1/provenance authorities, WP170 experiment OS/registry, wallet/Hermes/PIT, dependencies, workflows and all paper/execution/live surfaces remain unchanged. This implementation WP performs no real candidate evaluation and persists no real qualification receipt, experiment, OOS evidence, economic result, order or capital state.

semantic_fields.reason: These fields close qualification-gate identity, structural-vs-substantive semantics, append-only Alpha currentness, evidence sufficiency, deterministic aggregation and qualification-only authority without implementing a real evaluation or WP170.

items.required_rule: QualificationGateReceipt is immutable schema polymarket-qualification-gate-receipt/1.0.0 with policy qualification-gate-policy/1.0.0 and qualificationgate:sha256: identity over every normalized semantic field except its own id.
items.validation_rule: Exact-keyset mapping roundtrip, canonical ordering, closed dimensions/disposition, aggregation consistency and identity recomputation must pass; unknown fields, binary floats and self-consistent semantic forgeries reject.
items.safe_output: immutable receipt or closed control error

items.required_rule: Malformed, tampered, unbound or structurally unverifiable inputs are control rejections with no gate receipt; only structurally valid evaluations may produce QUAL_PASS, QUAL_FAIL or QUAL_INCONCLUSIVE.
items.validation_rule: Control rejection status/error vocabulary is closed and never converted into a substantive gate disposition.
items.safe_output: closed rejection code with no raw input echo

items.required_rule: The candidate-bound alpha_registry_head_entry_hash must occur in the current verified Alpha snapshot chain as an ancestor of or equal to the current head; equality to the current head is NOT required.
items.validation_rule: Unrelated append-only Alpha additions preserve eligibility; missing candidate-bound head, broken sequence/previous links, malformed records or incompatible history reject structurally.

items.required_rule: Across the current snapshot, the exact candidate/family lineage must still have exactly one leaf and that leaf must equal the candidate governing_research_episode_id with result_state RESEARCH_SUPPORTIVE.
items.validation_rule: Unrelated Alpha appends leave PASS; any later same-lineage episode, ambiguous leaves, stale selected episode or non-RESEARCH_SUPPORTIVE current leaf makes CURRENT_RESEARCH_LINEAGE FAIL rather than mutating the candidate.

items.required_rule: The supplied AF1GateReceipt must validate under the existing AF1 validator, exactly equal the candidate af1_gate_receipt_id, be FINALIZED AF1_PASS and carry the exact AF1 dimension keyset with every dimension PASS.
items.validation_rule: Wrong id, malformed receipt, non-final evidence, non-PASS disposition, missing dimension or authority broadening is a structural control rejection with no qualification receipt.

items.required_rule: The supplied ResearchProvenanceManifest set must validate, have sorted unique ids exactly equal to candidate research_provenance_manifest_ids, stay at/before the candidate cutoff, and cover every split-plan dataset snapshot reference.
items.validation_rule: Identity, exact-set, cutoff or split-dataset binding mismatch is a structural control rejection; the gate never substitutes event_time for knowability.
items.safe_output: verified manifest ids and cutoff relation

items.required_rule: PIT_PROVENANCE_READINESS passes only when every manifest has dq_flags exactly OK, replay_fidelity EXACT or FAITHFUL, gap_summary exactly empty, and the union of manifest input_evidence_reference_ids covers every feature, label, power-analysis and execution-feasibility evidence reference declared by the candidate.
items.validation_rule: Any non-OK DQ, PARTIAL/UNREPLAYABLE replay, nonempty gap_summary or unbound declared evidence reference yields INCONCLUSIVE; the gate does not dereference arbitrary opaque evidence ids or invent content truth.

items.required_rule: SAMPLE_POWER_READINESS passes only when available_sample_count >= required_sample_count, available_independent_group_count >= required_independent_group_count, and available_sample_count >= 3 * dataset_split_plan.min_samples_per_role.
items.validation_rule: Any shortfall yields INCONCLUSIVE, never automatic FAIL; the declared power method/reference/target/significance/MDE are consumed as frozen facts and no universal power calculator is introduced.

items.required_rule: WP170_CROSSING_READINESS means the already-valid candidate freezes enough hypothesis, feature/label, split, test-family and conditional B0/B1/B2 semantics to begin separately authorized candidate-specific WP170 construction; it does not claim immediate constructibility under the current FeatureDefinition public-non-market limitation.
items.validation_rule: Candidate validation and current experiment_os schema binding must pass; current WP170 SAFE_FEATURE_SOURCE_DEPENDENCIES are not broadened and experiment_os.py/experiment_registry.py remain unchanged.

items.required_rule: EXECUTION_EVIDENCE_READINESS passes only when FEES, RESOLUTION_RULES and TICK_SIZE_MIN_ORDER are AVAILABLE with provenance-bound evidence refs. SPREAD_DEPTH, LATENCY and PARTIAL_FILL may remain AVAILABLE, PARTIAL, MISSING or NOT_APPLICABLE and are carried forward to WP172.
items.validation_rule: Any critical foundation class not AVAILABLE, or any critical evidence ref not provenance-bound, yields INCONCLUSIVE; no spread/slippage/latency/capacity/PnL/sizing or profitability calculation occurs.

items.required_rule: Exactly eight ordered dimensions aggregate deterministically: any FAIL -> QUAL_FAIL; else any INCONCLUSIVE -> QUAL_INCONCLUSIVE; else all PASS -> QUAL_PASS. wp170_entry_eligible is true iff overall_disposition is QUAL_PASS.
items.validation_rule: FAIL has precedence over INCONCLUSIVE; caller cannot set disposition or eligibility independently.

items.required_rule: A valid QualificationGateReceipt has qualification-gate authority only. successor_authorization_required, no_strategy_authority, no_paper_authority, no_execution_authority, no_live_authority and no_gate_c_authority are exactly true.
items.validation_rule: Any authority broadening or false fixed flag invalidates the receipt; QUAL_PASS never authorizes WP170 execution, economics, paper, live or Gate C by itself.
